environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running as a systemd service under the 'app' user. Flask app served directly via Gunicorn on port 8080, fronted by an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). The instance IAM role has ec2:DescribeInstances and s3:GetObject permissions. No additional runtime sandboxing. PyYAML version 5.4.1 installed. Python 3.9 runtime.
